answer: Proposed gate: each ID/day donates 1 kWh to a workshop's pearl grader, prism polisher or walnut dryer. A trusted utility signs net-metered ID/day allocations; validators check quantity, signatures and nonreuse, denying listing on failure. Ten IDs need 10 x 1 = 10 kWh/day: shared generators or parallel delivery cannot reuse credited energy. Energy is a recurring input; generators are reusable capital; no stake. Utility collusion can fake delivery; surplus power can make marginal cash cost negligible. This meters delivery, not distinct owners.
